question.text: Let <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mover><mi>b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>c</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></math> be three vectors such that <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mover><mi>a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mover><mi>b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mover><mi>c</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>.</mo></math> If the projection of <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>b</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></math> along <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>a</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></math> is double of the projection of <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>c</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></math> along <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>a</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>b</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mover><mi>c</mi><mo>→</mo></mover></math> are perpendicular to each other, then the value of <math><mfrac><mrow><msup><mrow><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mrow><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>a</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>-</mo><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>b</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>c</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac></math> is equal to

solution.text:
Given, b→⋅c→=0

 b→⋅a^=2c→⋅a^⇒b→⋅a→=2c→⋅a→

So, a→-b→+2c→2=a→2+b→2+4c→2-2a→⋅b→-4b→⋅c→+4a→⋅c→

a→-b→+c→22=4+1+362=20.5
